objectives.text: Close the IMF track and keep the fiscal room it leaves. The Extended Credit Facility (US$3bn, 39 months, approved May 2023) ended with the sixth and final review on 27 July 2026, releasing about US$371m; a 36-month non-financing Policy Coordination Instrument follows, with a 2026 primary surplus target of 1.5% of GDP and a debt goal of 45% of GDP by 2034.

grand_strategy.reading: Mahama's government, in office since January 2025, inherits an IMF programme that closes in July 2026 with the debt restructuring largely done, but the fiscal room it buys is narrow and rests on gold prices. Its external currency is transactional: a UK trade framework from 2021 and a 2025 US deportation arrangement, while the northern border is where the Sahel juntas reach Accra. The sources in this pass do not cover the AES outreach, the ECOWAS neighbours, the EU, China, the Gulf or the 2025 anti-LGBT bill, so those rows and stances are open gaps.

stances.note: Transactional tie. The one documented structural link in this pass is the 2025 deportation arrangement, named by the US National Security Strategy among its deportation partners; that source documents the deal and does not grade Ghana's posture, so partner is our reading (confidence C). Trend stable is not sourced: the 2025 US visa restrictions, the aid cut and the AGOA question were not checked in this pass and may move the trend. Bond none: no kinship or grievance documented here.

stances.note: Cooperation out of necessity under strain. Reluctant partner is our reading (C): relations soured after the 2022 coup and the December 2022 summons, yet security cooperation tightened after the 14 February 2026 Titao attack that killed Ghanaian traders (AFP). The necessity is the JNIM spillover across a porous northern border. The resisting-alignment half is not sourced here. Trend warming is our reading: seven instruments signed in February 2026 and boundary talks in June 2026, against the strain of 2022-25. Bond none: the index notes Sankara-era closeness, which is historical; no current kinship or grievance is documented. Sources are press and advocacy analysis, not official statements.

stances_toward.note: Rewritten from Nigeria's side on 2026-10-16 (replaces the provisional reciprocal of Ghana's stance). Partner, not ally: the tie is gas and the shared bloc. Mirror: the Ghana card reads partner, affinity, stable, on the ECOWAS membership alone; the gas evidence is new. Bond affinity is the Ghana card's reading. Not sourced: 2026 bilateral contacts, trade and the traders' disputes.
